entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-14
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • .NET segfaults instead of showing error when OpenSSL config is invalid #122538
  • [API Proposal] System.Security.Cryptography.Oid.FromFriendlyName should not throw exception if FriendlyName is unknown #122536

Closed

  • Incorrect UInt128 to double conversion for values >= 2^104 #122532
  • Address sanitizer: Crash/deadlock in inject signal handler on Linux with glibc >= 2.40 #121581
    10.0.x

PullRequests

Created

  • Remove `@available` annotations where allowed. #122539
    area-System.Security, os-ios, 11.0.0
  • Include CMakeConfigureLog in logs artifacts #122537
    area-Infrastructure-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Fix UInt128 to double conversion for values >= 2^104 #122534
    area-System.Numerics, community-contribution
  • Fix #74020: Optimize consecutive shifts in JIT Lowering #122533
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
  • Add fast path to Array.ConstrainedCopy for single-dimensional arrays #122530
    area-System.Runtime, tenet-performance

Merged

  • Use TaskHostFactory to resolve file lock issues and simplify tasks build #122525
    area-Infrastructure
  • Redo fix lookup for current Thread in async signal handler #122513
    area-VM-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • [ilasm] Treat errors in -ERR mode as warnings #122270
    area-ILTools-coreclr

Updated

  • Remove implicit string operator from Utf8String #122149
    community-contribution, area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Switch Apple's digest functionality to CryptoKit #120953
    area-System.Security, cryptographic-docs-impact
  • Inconsistent MemoryCache stats #116193
    area-Extensions-Caching, community-contribution
  • [RISC-V] Fix 64-bit offset handling in `emitLoadImmediate` #122501
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution, arch-riscv
  • Fix Mono Debugger 200ms Pause (Issue #122344) #122449
    area-Debugger-mono, community-contribution
  • Fix build failure on "Packs" #122527
    community-contribution, needs-area-label
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #122478
    area-codeflow
  • Enable runtime async for native AOT testing #122526
    NO-MERGE, area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • [RuntimeAsync] Remove reflection TODOs. Add tests. #122517
    area-VM-coreclr, runtime-async, 11.0.0
